objective: Build a reusable single-tenant frontend foundation and continue system, workflow, and AI modules without duplicating visual or integration contracts.

requirements.statement: Theme presets change the complete visual system and persist.
Side, top, and mixed navigation layouts are selectable and persist.
Typed shared UI components provide consistent page, table, form, status, and empty-state presentation.
Dynamic menu rendering is recursive and independent of root ordering.
System administration modules provide authenticated CRUD flows.
acceptance: users roles orgs menus dicts configs

requirements.statement: Workflow definitions and approval runtime have explicit versioned contracts.
AI models and future module capabilities use a server-side, audited integration contract.

options.name: Separate shells per theme and layout
